rows.ARS:
Apricot or apricot blend Floribunda.
Registration name: FRYrelax
rows.Origin: Bred by Gareth Fryer (1948-....) (United Kingdom, before 1987).
rows.Bloom: Orange - apricot, pink shading, vermilion shading. Moderate fragrance. Medium to large, double (17-25 petals), cluster-flowered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Parentage:
Alexander ® (hybrid tea, Harkness, 1972) ×
Silver Jubilee ® (hybrid tea, Cocker before 1974)
rows.Notes: Fryer's Roses says Pensioners Voice is without doubt one of the best roses around today... this rose has beautifully formed flowers of bright orange-arpicot, with occasional tints of pink and vermilion...

colour: Orange - apricot, pink shading, vermilion shading.
